system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You’ve reached the pinnacle as your clansmen look to you for inspiration as you bring the full wrath of a raging typhoon into every battle. As a bonus action, you enter your Wind Scythe state, for the next minute, after which you cannot activate this battle state until you complete a long rest. While your Wind Scythe state is active you gain the following benefits:

You gain the benefit of both Pressure Front and Razor Jet while in your Divine Wind stance.

Jutsu you cast without the Wind Release keyword can gain the Swirl effect by spending 1 High Pressure.

Once per turn when you deal Slashing or Wind damage, by spending 1 High Pressure, you can inflict 1 rank of Bleed to all damaged creatures.

You can use either Jet Needle or Cleave as an Action. If you do they force Dexterity saving throws vs your highest jutsu save DC.

Jet Needle deals 8d6 Slashing or Wind damage on a failed saving throw or half as much on a success.

Cleave allows you to select three points, drawing a line from the first point to the second to the third and deals 6d6 Slashing or Wind damage and inflicts 2 ranks of Bleed on a failed save or half as much damage on a success.
